item.title: Bet Max Action Partners with Mach Five Tech to Power Tournament-Based Sports Gaming Platform
item.description: For Immediate Release March 1, 2026 — Bet Max Action today announced a strategic product and platform partnership with Mach Five Tech to design, build, and scale a tournament-based sports gaming platform focused on fan engagement, flexibility, and rapid deployment across markets. The partnership centers on the development of Bet Max Tourney, a full-stack tournament application, and the supporting platform infrastructure that lets Bet Max Action launch, test, and iterate quickly while supporting future integrations with sportsbooks, media partners, and international operators.

item.title: Bet Max Tourney
item.description: Bet Max Tourney revolutionizes sports betting by transforming traditional wagering into engaging, tournament-style competitions for operators and players.

item.title: Platform
item.description: Bet Max Action provides enterprise-grade gaming platform technology for operators seeking to scale their gaming offerings with proven, compliant infrastructure.
